en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph showing a group of mounted soldiers parading through a rural or semi-urban setting. On either side of the street, a large crowd of civilians, many of whom appear to be women and children dressed in traditional folk costumes, are waving handkerchiefs or cloths in greeting or celebration. Leafless trees and a fence are visible in the background, indicating a colder season, possibly autumn or early spring.
